name: containerlab-unified-command-result-records
instr:
containerlab cannot durably record command attempts and completion independently of normal presentation. Add opt-in, versioned recording for deploy, inspect, exec, generate, events, graph, save, and destroy without changing established behavior.

Record command, arguments, optional topology, unique invocation, producer-ordered observations, and exactly one completed, partial, failed, or cancelled state. Preserve partial per-node outcomes, events, artifacts, deletions, and generation through failure or cancellation. Distinguish fresh, reconciliation, and dry-run deploy work. Record empty, summary, and detailed inspect results independently of stdout format.

Publish atomically. Preserve prior committed bytes on failure and expose interrupted material for reporting, recovery, or discard. Use one decoder and version contract across all eight commands and reject unsupported versions. Publication must preserve stdout, stderr, returned errors, exit classification, generated files, runtime effects, and existing side effects. `NewResultSession(store ResultStore, command string, arguments []string, topology string) (*ResultSession, error)`, `NewFileResultStore(destination string) ResultStore`, and `DecodeResultRecord(data []byte) (*ResultRecord, error)` provide session creation, storage, and decoding.

Generate then deploy records generation first and publishes one terminal outcome. Interrupted events preserve the older commit, report incomplete residue, and retain source order. Mixed
